answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital, ensuring each thread of participation costs real economic value. Much like a willow bending under weight, the network remains flexible yet anchored by staked assets. An attacker cannot simply pen a sonnet of fake identities; they must acquire enough tokens to overcome the economic hurdle of block validation, making large-scale deception prohibitively expensive and computationally futile.
